item.title: Touring The Galaxy 2026
item.description: Touring the Galaxy is a recurring public outreach astronomy event held at the Natural Tunnel State Park. All are welcome whether you have a telescope or not. Park volunteers will take you on a journey through space using your own two eyes and a telescope. You will hear descriptions of many objects and constellations in the night sky and get the chance to see things you have never seen before!

item.title: New Site!
item.description:
Welcome to the new version of the Southwest Virginia Astronomy website!

Please bear with me as I update it and get content posted. This change was made due to the old version of the site being difficult to maintain and because a full Wordpress site is overkill for what this site is used for.

If you are new here, welcome! This is intended as a place where more technical and long form posts can be made since most people are not going to be interested in reading long form content on Facebook. I post full tutorials, articles, and observing logs here as well as any recurring local events I know about.

item.title: About
item.description: Welcome to the site! This is mostly a companion site to the Southwest Virginia Astronomy Facebook group and page. The purpose is to have somewhere to post more detailed content when those interested can read it. If you like what I do and would like to support me, you can do so by donating at any of the links below or by ordering from my Society6 store if you want a physical item with a picture of space taken from right here in Southwest Virginia.
